page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, no margin notes, no headings. Printed page number 366 at top left, running head "DE CONNEXIONIS" beneath it. Catchword "feriam" at bottom right.

main_text.p: fari,cumq; per eam intelligamus, quomodo anni irri- perij Augufti reuocandi fint ad annos Iulianos & Chrifti. Sed vt magis innotefcat annū decimū fextum Iulianum effe primum annum Actiacum ; ex Cenfo- rino probe notandum eft, Actiacam Augufti victo- riam bienio antiquiore effe triumpho Auguftali, qui incurrit in annū ineuntem 18 Iulianum: vnde colligi- tur Cenforinū biennij illius initiū fupputare à kal. Ia- nuariis ineuntis anni Iuliani decimi fexti, licet poft o- cto demū menfes inciderit Augufti Actiaca victoria, labente anno Olympiadico 747, hoc eft, anno tertio Olympiadis centefimæ octogefimæ feptimæ, quem- admodum etiā recte tradit Eufebius in Chronicis, vbi hifce verbis defcribit Actiacam Augufti victoriam: Cleopatra & Antonium femet interficiunt, & Ægyptus fit Romana provincia, quam primus tenuit Caius Cornelius Gallus, de quo Virgilius scribit in Bucolicis. Quod autem monarchia Augufti coeperit ab Actiaca victoria, indeq; æra tempori s fuerit inftituta, Xiphilinus e Dio- ne recitat hifce verbis, [?]τοιαῦτα μὲν τῆς ἡ ναυμαχία [illegible, ~12 letters] Σεβαστὸς ἐγένετο. τότε δὲ ἐκ ἀλλως [?] [illegible, ~25 letters] ἡμέρας [?] [illegible, ~15 letters] Καίσαρ [illegible, ~20 letters] h.e. tale nauale praeliū inter ipsos comissum fuit die fecunda Septembris. hoc autē aliter nusquam dixi (neq; enim foleo id facere) atq; tūc primum Caesar potentia omnē folus obtinuit, vt inde monarchiæ ipsius anni & præcise ab illa die numerarentur. Cum autem Thoth Actiacus fecundum Ægy- ptios incidisset in 29 Augufti fiue Sextilis iuxta ratio- nem perturbati calendarij, factū deinde est vt primo anno Diocletiani Tyranni, currete anno Chrifti 284 figeretur Thoth Coptitarū ad 29 quoq; Augufti die, feriam

page.notes: Greek passages (after "ne recitat hifce verbis" and at the start of the line "h.e. tale") are only partly legible at this scan resolution; the marked fragments are best readings, and the bracketed spans are illegible. The printed text has "teporis" for "temporis" in the Latin line "indeq; æra tempori s fuerit inftituta" and I have followed the printed spacing as far as it is visible. No marginal notes or footnotes are printed on this page.
